newsitem.title: UK: First Leisure confident on H1 profits.
newsitem.headline: First Leisure confident on H1 profits.

text.p: Britain's First Leisure Corp Plc said on Monday it expected its profits before asset disposals in the first-half to April 30 to be "at least" in line with last year.
The company said overall sales were 7.0 percent ahead of last year, with each division, except for its bingo unit, posting a solid improvement in like-for-like sales.
"Consumer demand in leisure markets has remained steady overall with little evidence of a consumer boom," the firm said in a statement.
First Leisure said comparable sales were up 3.0 percent at its nightclubs and bars business, about 4.0 percent higher at its sports unit, and 11 ahead at its resorts division.
Comparable bingo sales dropped 25 percent, partly due to new competition, the firm said.
First Leisure's shares firmed 2.5p to 330 at 1235 GMT.
The company planned to report first-half results on June 24.
